primary_claim: Deployment Simulation, which replays real prior conversations with a new candidate model, predicted the direction of production-rate change for behavior categories 92% of the time versus 54% for a challenging-prompts baseline, for categories whose rates changed by at least 1.5x in the GPT-5.4 study.

effect.metric: direction-of-change prediction accuracy for production rates (categories with >=1.5x change)

stated_future_work: make the deployment simulation pipeline easier to run so it can play a larger role in future model development
limitations_stated: the hardest case is agentic tool use, where realistic behavior depends on external state: filesystems, connectors, syscalls, network services, and prior tool results
this is not a replacement for traditional evals
quote: For categories whose production rates changed by at least 1.5x, deployment simulation predicted the direction of change 92% of the time, compared with 54% for a baseline built from challenging prompts.
